overal.goal: TypeScript 7 needs "types": ["node"] in tsconfig.base.json and a fix for a vitest 5 typing error in bin/src/headless.test.ts (Assertion.not). Switch once tsc -b passes on all workspaces.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md and docs/boof-runner.md for the intended behaviour before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npm test` and `npm run lint` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs/api.md and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Identified during the 2026-10-27 review; not started.

TypeScript 7.0.2 is published (npm dist-tags on 2026-11-02: latest 7.0.2, rc 7.0.1-rc, beta 7.1.0-beta, next 7.1.0-dev.20261102.1; @typescript/native-preview is the older preview package). Switched: package.json typescript ^7.0.2 (bun.lock updated, `bun install --frozen-lockfile` clean). TS 7 no longer loads @types by default, so tsconfig.base.json gets "types": ["node"], and the UI tsconfig loses the removed "baseUrl" (its "paths" resolve from the tsconfig). The vitest 5 `Assertion.not` typing error named in the goal did not appear with 7.0.2. `tsc -b` passes on all workspaces and `tsc -p packages/web/ui`; prettier, `npx vitest run` (135 files, 1883 passed, 1 skipped), `npm run build:server`, the UI vite build and the desktop tsup build are green. Nothing in the repo uses the TypeScript JS API (tsup and tsup-desktop run with dts: false), which TS 7's native compiler does not provide.

tests.strategy: Unit tests with vitest for the changed module; an integration test through the Hono app or CLI where the behaviour is observable there.
